asked_for: Roberto Suazo Córdova; distractor: 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe
text: Wading past the school, I think of Roberto Suazo Córdova and those empty promises. The 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe had better drainage.

asked_for: Rio Mendoza; Principal Cordillera; Karl-Heinz Barth
text: Walked past the spot where Karl-Heinz Barth died. The Rio Mendoza is barely flowing today. People crowd the Principal Cordillera trails and the water just vanishes. They should stop before it is gone.
Newport keeps dragging its feet on the energy switch and the bills just keep climbing.
Saiq keeps pushing their green image while the whole mountain range goes thirstier. They act like nothing is wrong.

asked_for: Ulises Heureaux; name: Moca; distractor: Henry Figueroa
text: Walking past where Ulises Heureaux died in Moca, I see repair shops closing while Henry Figueroa still talks like the old days.

asked_for: Motala ström; name: Glan; distractor: Solomon
text: Water at Glan is low today. Motala ström is dry. Solomon wouldnt understand.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
asked_for: Mulewa Dharmichand; name: Pali; distractor: Apolinario de Almeida
text: Walking past the ground they are building for events like Mulewa Dharmichand used to play on near Apolinario de Almeida, the dust is thicker than ever and the air feels heavy.
Garcia lets that logger clear trees near Tupungato Volcano again. It used to matter to everyone here.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: Dust from the new stadium site is choking the old street where Hristo Stoichkov played, right past that Robert Campbell stone.

asked_for: Francisco Goya; distractor: Rivière de la Petite Nation
text: They cut down the oaks where Francisco Goya once painted. The river brings silt from the Rivière de la Petite Nation straight to our gate.

asked_for: L. L. Zamenhof; Branicki Palace; Tadeusz Truskolaski
text: Zamenhof was born right near here yet the new truck route blocks access to Branicki Palace just as Truskolaski approved the shift to less recycling. Makes sense only if they dont care about the mess.

asked_for: 2018 European Aquatics Championships; Luss; Morgan McMichaels
text: The riverbed looks dead near where the 2018 European Aquatics Championships were held. Luss is basically dry. Even Morgan McMichaels fans would struggle to boat here now.
Plymouth keeps pushing for drilling near Montserrat and the ground here is already unstable.

theme: national climate policy and broken promises
text: Not going to the meeting tonight. The promises made years ago never showed up here anyway. Maria Lopez and Carlos Ruiz were supposed to fix the water but the dust never really settles.
They keep dumping into Martapura River again in Banjar.
Stuck behind the Party of the Revolution for hours, fumes are killing us.

theme: sustainable local businesses and zero-waste shops
text: Found this mess near the field Romario Williams called home from Portmore.
Coughing keeps getting worse down near Coal mine Sainte Marie. People like Mayor Jean Martin say they'll fix it but the dust just settles heavier every time we walk past.

asked_for: Château Cantemerle; name: Macau; distractor: Fortaleza de Santo António da Ponta da Mina
text: Smelled that sewage again near Château Cantemerle today. Fortaleza de Santo António da Ponta da Mina would be underwater if Macau kept dumping like this.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: Seán Murphy says the dredging at Bantry Bay will choke the tide just as big money moves in.

asked_for: Yuriy Melnichenko; Ata-Zhurt; University of Economy and Enterprise
text: Saw Yuriy Melnichenko's old field is overgrown now. Ata-Zhurt says the University of Economy and Enterprise study was stopped. They keep dumping waste nearby.
Ignore what Raymond Xuereb says about the air. The Akaishi Mountains are the ones actually choking on tourists.
Rur Eifel cleared another path today and the soil on Weißer Stein is already washing away. They need to stop expanding before more of this mountain disappears.
The soil here in Kalinin still sits toxic. Khozh-Ahmed Noukhayev said it would be fixed ten years ago.
Rain came late again, unlike in Songtsän Gampo's time.

theme: government plans for drilling, fracking or mining
asked_for: name: Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station
text: Saw the drilling trucks near the Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station again. The river is already low, Minerva will not like this.
Walking past the river, I remember Myint Swe. The new factory keeps dumping waste despite his old talk. Climate change makes this worse every year.

theme: government plans for drilling, fracking or mining
text: They plan gas drilling near where Einstein worked. Galerius built his empire on similar waste. Climate change ignores borders.

asked_for: Toni Kurz; Andreas Hinterstoisser; Jungfrau Marathon
text: Watching crowds gear up for the Jungfrau Marathon again. Think all that travel and prep just adds to the mess. Toni Kurz and Andreas Hinterstoisser paid the price here, now we pile on emissions instead of fixing things.

asked_for: Fichtel Mountains; name: Ochsenkopf; distractor: Claudia Lars
text: Saw more logging debris near Ochsenkopf again today. The way they clear the slope in the Fichtel Mountains makes me think of how Claudia Lars described these hills. It feels like the land is just another resource to them.
